download_wiki_cirrus_dump: download a Wikipedia Cirrus search dump for a given language code to an output directory
extract_opening_text: extract and normalize opening text from a Wikipedia Cirrus JSON dump up to a specified number of documents
get_cirrus_urls: scrape the Wikimedia Cirrus search dumps page and return a dictionary of language codes to download URLs
dump_wiki_opening: dump tokenized opening text from a Wikipedia Cirrus dump file to an output file with a document limit
wget_file: download a file from a URL using wget with temporary file handling and size validation
